cases.source: 读者是业务负责人和财务负责人。当前在线客服首次响应时间中位数为 18 分钟，客服需要在多个知识库之间手工查找答案。建议用四周做客服辅助试点：系统只为 20 名在线客服推荐回复，由客服确认后发送；首期不处理电话客服，也不允许自动发送。参与人员为产品经理 1 人、客服主管 1 人、工程师 2 人，预算上限 12 万元。验收方法是比较试点前后同类咨询的首次响应时间中位数、人工改写率和错误回复数；通过条件为首次响应时间中位数不高于 10 分钟、没有未经人工确认的发送。主要风险是知识库内容过期和权限配置错误，分别由客服主管每周复核知识库、工程师在上线前检查权限。需要管理层批准四周试点范围和 12 万元预算。

# synclite

## Repository layout

src/ holds the engine, adapters/ holds storage adapters, scripts/release.sh cuts releases.

## Releasing

Maintainers run scripts/release.sh after setting NPM_TOKEN and GH_TOKEN in CI secrets.

## About

synclite syncs a local SQLite file to S3-compatible storage on every commit. Requires Node 20+.

A GCS adapter is planned but not implemented.

## Usage

Run `synclite watch ./app.db --bucket my-bucket`.

Requires Node 20+.

## Install

`npm install -g synclite`

## License

MIT

# pgsnap

## Architecture

pgsnap uses a WAL reader, a chunker, and an uploader. The chunker splits WAL segments into 4 MB blocks; the uploader retries with exponential backoff.

## Development

Run `make dev` to start Postgres in Docker. Integration tests need AWS credentials in .env.

## What is pgsnap

pgsnap continuously backs up a PostgreSQL database to S3.

## Usage

`pgsnap run --db postgres://localhost/app --bucket backups`

## License

Apache-2.0
